commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Solenoid Valve 6 (N93) Open or Short to Ground
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Repair Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Solenoid Valve 6 (N93)

Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Solenoid Valve 6 (N93)
See Measuring Value Blocks (MVB)
Perform Output Test
technicalNotes: On some transmissions, the OE wiring diagrams do not have Solenoid Valve 6 (N93), it can be refereed to as the Pressure Control Valve 3 (N217).
